description: This file is a shell script that provides utility functions and checks related to CVS (Concurrent Versions System) and git version control systems. It includes functions for setting up CVS repositories, checking out branches, comparing branches, and verifying file or directory consistency between CVS and git repositories, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository by copying existing CVS root directory structure into a designated directory.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out a CVS branch, either main or a specified branch name, into a directory, cleaning previous checkout if necessary.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out a specified branch in a git repository within a test environment.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares a specific file in CVS and git checked-out branches to ensure they match.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Checks out a specific branch from CVS and git, then compares the full directory trees and file contents to verify they are identical.
